name: com.atlantflow/hvac-booking
title: AtlantFlow AC & Heat
description: HVAC facts, service-area check, cost ranges and callback booking for AtlantFlow, Boca Raton FL.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Basic facts about AtlantFlow AC & Heat: legal and trade name, Florida license, founding year, address, phone, email, website, brands serviced, certifications. Use for 'who are they / how do I contact them / are they licensed'.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the HVAC services AtlantFlow offers (AC repair, replacement, maintenance plan, heating, mini-splits, thermostats, indoor air quality, commercial HVAC and refrigeration, emergency service) with a short description and page URL for each.

category.description: Optional filter: residential, commercial or emergency. Omit for everything.
category.title: Category

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether AtlantFlow serves a location. Returns status 'served' (primary service area), 'ask' (listed or nearby but availability must be confirmed by phone) or 'not_served' (outside Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade). Give a ZIP whenever possible.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, e.g. '33487'. Preferred - gives a definite answer.
zip.title: Zip

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Delray Beach'. Used when no ZIP is known.
city.title: City

tools.name: get_hours_and_emergency
tools.description: AtlantFlow's hours: whether regular service hours are open at a given moment (default now), whether the $149 emergency call fee applies at that time, and the rules for Sundays and nights. Calls are answered 24/7.

datetime.description: Optional local time (America/New_York) as ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-11-01T19:30'. Omit for right now.
datetime.title: Datetime

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published AtlantFlow prices (diagnostic, emergency call fee, tune-up, maintenance plan, financing) plus historical invoice statistics by job type (median and middle-half range, number of jobs). Only groups with 20+ jobs are published; no per-city prices. Statistics describe past invoices, not a quote.

service.description: Optional keyword to filter historical job statistics, e.g. 'replacement', 'leak', 'drain', 'thermostat', 'capacitor'. Omit to list everything.
service.title: Service

tools.name: estimate_replacement_cost
tools.description: Ballpark cost range for a full residential AC system replacement in AtlantFlow's service area, from the company's own closed invoices (median and middle-half range with sample size). NOT a quote: the final price needs a free in-home estimate. Returns no estimate for ZIPs outside Palm Beach/Broward/Miami-Dade.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the home, e.g. '33487'.
zip.title: Zip

home_sqft.description: Optional conditioned home size in square feet. Context only; it does not change the statistic.
home_sqft.title: Home Sqft

tools.name: get_membership_and_financing
tools.description: AtlantFlow's maintenance plan (single plan, $200/year per system, two visits a year), the single-visit tune-up ($149), and financing (from $89/month, $0 down on approved credit), plus the warranty rules.

tools.name: get_second_opinion_info
tools.description: The free second-opinion service for homeowners who received an AC replacement quote from another company: what is covered, that it is free, and how to ask for it.

tools.name: get_reviews_summary
tools.description: Customer rating summary: Google rating and review count and Thumbtack rating, each with the date it was checked. Use when asked about reputation. Counts change over time; the date shows how fresh they are.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: How to reach or book AtlantFlow: phone (answered 24/7), the website callback/booking form, the contact page, and the request_service tool.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Ask AtlantFlow to call a customer back about service. ONLY call when the person explicitly asked to be contacted and gave their name, phone and ZIP. Side effect: creates a lead in AtlantFlow's Housecall Pro CRM and notifies the office; nothing is deleted or overwritten. Not idempotent but protected: repeated identical requests are de-duplicated and rate-limited, so do not retry on success. This is a callback request, not a confirmed appointment. For emergencies the person should call (561) 510-9414 directly.

issue.description: What is wrong or what is needed, e.g. 'AC blowing warm air', 'quote for new system'. 3-600 characters.
issue.title: Issue

preferred_time.description: Preferred callback or visit time, free text (optional).
preferred_time.title: Preferred Time

website.description: Anti-spam honeypot. Leave EMPTY. Never fill this field.
website.title: Website

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AtlantFlow's published HVAC articles. Use when a homeowner asks why their AC does something (not cooling, freezing up, strange noises, high humidity, no heat) or how to troubleshoot or maintain a system in South Florida. Returns ranked articles with title, URL, summary and date; call get_article for the full text. Cite the URL when answering.

query.description: What the homeowner asks, in plain words, e.g. 'AC freezing up', 'humidity in house', 'strange noise from outdoor unit', 'no heat'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read the full text of one AtlantFlow article (troubleshooting steps, causes, typical South Florida advice) by URL or id. Use after search_articles or list_articles, to answer a homeowner's how-to or why-is-my-AC-doing-X question. Includes the publication date, the license line and a call-to-action. Article costs are general ranges, not a quote.

url_or_id.description: Article URL (as returned by search_articles / list_articles) or numeric id.
url_or_id.title: Url Or Id

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List AtlantFlow's published HVAC articles, newest first, optionally filtered by topic. Use to browse what guidance exists (AC not cooling, freezing, noises, humidity, heating) before answering a South Florida homeowner's question.

topic.description: Optional topic/category filter, e.g. 'HVAC', 'Maintenance' (case-insensitive substring). Omit for all.
topic.title: Topic
